title: The Bakery of the Crescent Cove
author: Gideon Vane
blurb: Casper Pemberton, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
